title: Valid Triangle by Three Sides

content.problemStatement: Write a program to check whether the given three sides can form a triangle or not.
content.inputFormat: Accept three integer as a input

solution.approach: Check triangle inequality theorem: a + b > c, a + c > b, and b + c > a.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Three sides can form a triangle if the sum of any two sides is strictly greater than the third. Print 'Valid' or 'Not Valid'.

hints: Recall triangle inequality: sum of any two sides must exceed the third.
Check (a + b > c) && (a + c > b) && (b + c > a).
learningObjectives: Combine multiple inequality conditions with logical AND.
